subject.title: doctor: legacy WhatsApp ackReaction with direct plus group mentions migrates to group-mentions, silently dropping DM ack reactions

question: Should OpenClaw add a canonical acknowledgement scope for “direct messages plus mentioned groups” so doctor can migrate existing WhatsApp legacy settings without narrowing behavior?
rationale: The reported legacy behavior cannot be represented by the current shared scope enum, so implementation requires choosing a durable cross-channel config contract rather than only correcting a mapping branch.

options.title: Add a lossless shared scope
options.body: Introduce a canonical direct-plus-mentioned-groups scope, migrate the WhatsApp legacy combination to it, and test the shared scope behavior.

options.title: Refuse the lossy migration
options.body: Leave the legacy setting untouched and have doctor explain that the existing canonical model cannot preserve its behavior until a product decision is made.

options.title: Intentionally narrow behavior
options.body: Document and warn that legacy direct acknowledgements are dropped during migration, accepting the compatibility break explicitly.

recommendation.title: Add a lossless shared scope
recommendation.body: Introduce a canonical direct-plus-mentioned-groups scope, migrate the WhatsApp legacy combination to it, and test the shared scope behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the most concrete current investigation and reproduction evidence available for the specific migration contract.
